Human Architecture Decision: Authorize an Application-layer coordination container pattern for cases where one canonical Domain response updates multiple independent Domain state axes (CharacterPostureState and WeaponActionState for ammo depletion).

Container is an Application orchestration snapshot/aggregate holding references to canonical Domain state values; it is NOT canonical Domain ownership or structural decomposition between character and weapon.

Coordination pattern requires immutable copy-on-write whole-container replacement (construct complete next snapshot before replacing/exposing reference) to avoid exposing partially updated coordination snapshots.

Guarantee is strictly an in-memory Application reference-replacement guarantee; it is NOT database transactional atomicity, ACID, rollback, distributed atomicity, or concurrency/version-control semantics.
MagazineAmmoState, STUN/control status, and SquadPostureIntent are NOT included.
EventBatch is a Domain evaluation-wave kernel and is NOT the Application integration mechanism for AmmoDepletionResponse.
EffectIntent boundary is preserved (strictly effect-producing logic, not universal mutation or Application coordination).

Stale-response architectural risk is recorded and synchronous resolution/replacement preferred, while stale-response failure policy (throw/return false/no-op/event) remains unresolved; no invented concurrency frameworks.
Zero Domain/Application/Presentation implementation files or tests are modified in T-025.
Historical T-000 through T-024 records and events are preserved without modification.
